command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest -q -o junit_family=legacy tests/test_*conduction.py --junitxml=results.xml
reference: Insulated cell and storing wall, each with capacity 1 J/K, linked by conductance 2 W/K. Relative to 305 K, initial deviations are +A and -A, A=2^-50 K. Exact cell/wall deviations at time t are +/-A*exp(-4t), integral heat into the cell is A*(exp(-4t)-1) in SI units. Compare full run to individual CN steps using both returned states; fields must match bit-for-bit. A separate test checks absolute coordinates and active-face order for mixed boundary types.
